phases.description: Teacher can add and find physical book copies through a durable searchable catalogue.
phases.label: MILESTONE 1
phases.name: Durable catalogue

phases.description: Teacher can lend a copy to a pupil and record its return through the browser.
phases.label: MILESTONE 2
phases.name: Circulation

phases.description: Teacher accepts finding, lending and returns with restart preservation and documented recovery; overdue functionality is excluded.
phases.label: MILESTONE 3
phases.name: First-version acceptance

phases.description: Explicitly deferred until first-version acceptance: teacher sees outstanding overdue loans and their due dates.
phases.label: MILESTONE 4
phases.name: After first version: overdue list
